Volume 10, Issue 13, 15 July 2024, e33419. # Review article Towards energy efficiency: A comprehensive review of deep learning-based photovoltaic power forecasting strategies. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e33419Get rights and content. Time series forecasting still awaits a transformative breakthrough like that happened in computer vision and natural language processing. To address these issues, a systematic review of the state-of-the-art literature on prediction tasks is presented, collected from the Web of Science and Scopus databases, published in 2022 and 2023, and filtered using keywords such as “photovoltaic,” “deep learning,” “forecasting,” and “time series.” Finally, 36 case studies were selected. Before comparing, a state-of-the-art demonstration of key elements in the topic was presented, such as model type, hyperparameters, and evaluation metrics. Root Mean Squared Error and Mean Absolute Error were the most utilized metrics, although they specifically demonstrate the accuracy relative to their respective sites. Finally, trends, challenges, and future research were highlighted for the relevant topic to spotlight and bypass the current challenges. ## Keywords.
